description: Arrange the chat, a shell, Git changes, your own terminals and other mods' panels freely: presets, moves, drag, focus keys and a panel registry

border.title: Panel frame
border.description: Corner and line style of the panel frames

side.title: Panel side
side.description: Which side of the chat the presets put the panels on

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: dock: one tabbed dock; stack: split panels in one column; columns: side by side; grid: two rows; corner: one panel below the chat, the rest full height

arrangement.title: Arrangement
arrangement.description: A full tree of chat and panel ids that replaces the layout preset, such as {"split": "horizontal", "children": ["chat", "terminal"]}

dock_size.title: Panel width (%)
dock_size.description: Share of the width the panels take in dock and stack, 15 to 85; resizing overrides it until /workspace reset

narrow_below.title: Narrow below (columns)
narrow_below.description: Below this width splits that hold the chat stack top to bottom and splits of panels become a row

shell_write.title: Shell writes the workspace
shell_write.description: Lets the Shell panel write files in the workspace, so git commit works

shell_network.title: Shell network
shell_network.description: none, or loopback for services on this computer

terminals.title: Terminal panels
terminals.description: Your own terminal panels: [{id, title, argv, write?, network?: "loopback"}], each sandboxed like the Shell

panels.title: Panel order
panels.description: Panel ids separated by commas, such as changes, terminal; panels left out are hidden and unknown ids show in /workspace config; empty shows built-ins, terminals, then registered panels

key_panel_1.title: Key: show panel 1
key_panel_1.description: A key such as h, Left, F2 or Ctrl+x; <disabled> turns it off
